blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: 2NF — No partial dependency on part of composite key.
3NF — No non-key transitive dependency violating key dependency.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: 1NF requires atomic values and no repeating groups in a record; 2NF removes dependencies on only part of a composite candidate key.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: 3NF eliminates inappropriate transitive dependencies among non-key facts, reducing repeated customer names across orders.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: An index accelerates some lookups but uses storage and may slow insert/update operations. Normalisation and indexing solve different problems.
